abort.invalid_discovery: The Garmin Connect MCP app sent invalid settings.
abort.set_up_by_app: This integration is set up automatically by the Garmin Connect MCP app. Install and start the app instead.

confirm.title: Restart Home Assistant
confirm.description: The Garmin Connect MCP app has updated its helper integration to version {version}. Home Assistant must be restarted once to load it. Click Submit to restart now.

garmin_login.title: Garmin Connect MCP: Garmin login of {name} no longer valid
garmin_login.description: The Garmin Connect login of the account **{name}** in the Garmin Connect MCP app is no longer valid – the AI assistant cannot read its Garmin data. Open **Garmin MCP** in the sidebar and log in again in the card of this account. This notice disappears by itself afterwards.

removal.title: Garmin Connect MCP removed
removal.message: The Garmin Connect MCP app was uninstalled, so its helper integration for remote access removed itself (including its files). Nothing else to do – a restart is not needed.
